# Calendar dependency

`lunar.js` is an unmodified vendored copy of [6tail/lunar-javascript](https://github.com/6tail/lunar-javascript), under the accompanying MIT license in `lunar-LICENSE.txt`.

Pinned upstream commit: `4c45a59f79b856125516f31aefa8295035c16afd`.

Only the Qimen panel loads this file. It supplies civil-date validation, sexagenary pillars and astronomical solar-term boundaries. Qimen placement and the site's plain-language explanations are in `qimen-core.js`.
